summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Dashboard SSE real-time activity updates. Green pulsing LIVE indicators visible on both Weekly Activity and Recent Activity sections. Bar chart shows 7 days with 4 series. Activity feed shows 10 items with timestamps. Stats cards update from SSE liveStats. Mobile responsive at 375px with vertical stacking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard SSE real-time features fully tested. Key data-testid attributes: user-dashboard, activity-graph, activity-feed, live-indicator, dashboard-activity-section, dashboard-stats, dashboard-quick-actions. SSE endpoint /api/dashboard/activity/stream sends 'init' event on connect with {graph, activities, stats}, then 'update' events every 20s when data changes, or 'ping' heartbeat.
